items.description: order read by id with only requireAuth: no check that the order belongs to the caller (the cancel route right below uses requireOrderOwner)
role change route under /admin has requireAuth but not requireRole('admin'), so any signed-in user can make themselves admin
refund route: any signed-in user can refund any order, and the amount is neither checked against what was paid nor against what was already refunded
invite acceptance never compares the invite's email with the caller, so anyone holding or guessing the token joins the team with the invited role (including owner)

decoys.description: cancel route is guarded by requireOrderOwner (defined in middleware/auth.ts)
list route filters on the caller's id
admin user list is guarded by requireRole('admin')
admin delete is guarded by requireRole('admin')
profile update compares the caller with the path id
invite creation asserts the caller owns the team (services/teamService.ts)
